title: RTP X
description: Premium Random Teleport Plugin with GUI for Overworld, Nether & End
body:
# ✦ RTPX — Premium Random Teleport Plugin

> **Created by NoTXGameR | UBMC STUDIO**

Teleport players to random safe locations across all dimensions with a sleek, fully-configurable GUI!

---

## ✨ Features

- 🗺️ Beautiful **GUI-based RTP** for Overworld, Nether & End
- ⏱️ Per-world **cooldown** & **countdown timer** (cancel on move)
- ✅ **Safe teleport** — avoids lava, water, void & unsafe ground
- 🔔 Action bar messages, titles, and sound effects
- 📊 **PlaceholderAPI** support (`%rtp_cooldown_<world>%`)
- 🔒 Full **LuckPerms** permission node support
- ♻️ `/rtp reload` — hot-reload config without restart
- 🎨 Fully customizable GUI (materials, slots, lore, colors)

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/rtp` | Open the RTP GUI | `rtp.use` |
| `/randomtp` | Alias for /rtp | `rtp.use` |
| `/rtp reload` | Reload config | `rtp.admin` |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Node | Default | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| `rtp.use` | Everyone | Use /rtp command |
| `rtp.gui` | Everyone | Open RTP GUI |
| `rtp.overworld` | Everyone | RTP in Overworld |
| `rtp.nether` | OP | RTP in Nether |
| `rtp.end` | OP | RTP in The End |
| `rtp.admin` | OP | Full admin access |

---

## 📦 Soft Dependencies

- [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)
- [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/)
- EssentialsX

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21 — 1.21.11
- **Platforms:** Spigot, Paper, Purpur

---

*Made with ❤️ by **NoTXGameR** — UBMC STUDIO*
